aniyatakaṇḍa:
[Aniyata+kaṇḍa] (pu) CL=8 The part which express the beginning of Vinayas (offence under monastic discipline) which is impermanent and indecisive
The part of Aniyata Vinayas (rules of conduct of the Buddhist Order)
aniyataniddesa: [Aniyata+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 A term that indicates something uncertain, undecided, variable, or not fixed. See also – aniyamaniddesavacana.
aniyatasikkhāpada:
[Aniyata+sikkhāpada] (na) CL=8 The Vinayas (rules of conduct of the Buddhist Order) which designate the  Vinayas (offence under monastic discipline).
Aniyata Vinayas (rules of conduct of the Buddhist Order)
aniyyāna:
[Na+niyyāna] (na) CL=8 1) Not leaving,  not marching to bettle, returning from the marching to bettle (Ti) 2) The Dhamma which is not about escapism
See also Aniyyāna - Dīpaka - Magga, Aniyyānika
aniyyānadīpaka:
[Na+niyyāna+dīpaka] (ti) CL=8 Not showing the way to escape from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences
See also Anatthapadasaṃhita
aniyyānamagga: [Aniyyāna+magga] (pu) CL=8 The path which is not showing the way to escape from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences, the evil path,  Micchattaniyata - Aniyata - Maga
aniyyānika: [Na+niyyānika] (ti) CL=9 Does escape from (1) (a) does not escape from  Vaṭṭa (b) be not in the habit of making release from Vaṭṭa. (c) be not in the habit of escaping from Vaṭṭa (2) being not for the sake of Magga and Phala; cannot give- bring Deva realms, Nibbāna. Dispensation, etc. (Fem.) (3) not worthy to attain or be associated with the Dhamma which is the cause to free from Duggati as well as Samsāra and the cause to attain Deva realm and Nibbāna. Not having the advantage of reaching Nibbāna; cannot escape from Vacīduccarita; the Dhamma; Tiracchānakathā. (4) does not eradicate the opposite defilements; not suitable.
aniyyānikabhāva: [Aniyyānika+bhāva] (pu) CL=8 The state of not being the way to escape from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences.
aniyyānikabhāvakathana: [Aniyyānikabhāva+kathana] (na) CL=8 Talking about the state which is not being the way to escape from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences..
aniyyānikakāraṇa: [Aniyyānika+kāraṇa] (na) CL=8 The reason of not escaping from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences. (habit / practice)
aniyyānikapakkha:
[Aniyyānika+pakkha] (pu) CL=8 The party practice of Dhamma which is not the way to escape from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences.
The practice of monk, the habit of living like a dog
aniyyānikapatha: [Aniyyānika+patha] (pu) CL=8 Not the way to escape from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences
aniyyānikapaṭipadā: [Aniyyānika+paṭipadā] (thī) CL=8 Not the practice to escape from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences
aniyyānikasāsana: [Aniyyānika+sāsana] (na) CL=8 The dispensation which is not the escapism from cyclic process impelled by the interaction of lust, deeds and consequences - not state of fruition on following the Right Path leading to Nirvana -
aniyyānikatta:
[Aniyyānika+tta] (na) CL=8 The state of being Aniyyānika
See also Aniyyānika
aniyyātetvā: [Na+niyyātetvā] (kri,vi) CL=8 1) Not giving away - not confering / awarding.  2) Not ending, not concluding
aniyyātita: [Na+niyyātita] (ti) CL=8 Not giving away - not confering / awarding
aniyyātitattabhāva: [Aniyyātita+attabhāva] (pu) CL=8 The person who has embodying a being which is not giving way - awarding -.
aniyāma:
[Na+niyāma] (ti) CL=8 1) Not having - decision - separation - notes / record - objectives - 2) The Dhamma which is not Sammatta law of nature but Micchatta law of nature
See also Aniyāmagamana
aniyāmagamana: [Na+niyāma+gamana] (na) CL=8 Reaching to Dhamma which is not Sammatta rule of law but Micchatta rule of law
aniyāmita: [Na+niyāmita] (ti) CL=8 Should not be decided, uncertain.  See also Aniyamita
aniyāmitapariccheda: [Aniyāmita+pariccheda] (pu) CL=8 The partition which is indecisive and uncertain
aniyāmitālapana: [Aniyāmita+ālapana] (na) CL=8 Naming / Calling without - decision - separation - specification -
aniñjamāna: [Na+iñjamāna] (ti) CL=8 The person who is not frightened / trembled
aniñjana: [Na+iñjana] (na,thī) CL=9 (1)  not tremble. (2) having no tremble. (B) There is no Dhamma that causes trembling (Nīvarana, etc). (C) The Dhamma which have no cause of the Dhamma of Rūpatanhā that shakes. See also Aniñjita. (3) the Dhamma that have no cause of shaking. See Aniñjita.
aniñjanaṭṭha: [Aniñjana+attha] (pu) CL=8 Having the meaning / nature which is not trembled /frightened - which has no movements -

aniṭṭhagandha: [Aniṭṭha+gandha] (pu) CL=8 The smell which is undesirable - bad -
aniṭṭhaphala:
[Aniṭṭha+phala] (na) CL=8 The effect which is undesirable - bad - (Aniṭṭha)
See also Kaṭukapphala
aniṭṭhaphassa: [Aniṭṭha+phassa] (pu) CL=8 The meeting / experience which is undesirable - bad -
aniṭṭharasa: [Aniṭṭha+rasa] (pu) CL=8 The taste which is undesirable - bad -.
aniṭṭharūpa: [Aniṭṭha+rūpa] (na) CL=8 A) The nature / philosophy of Aniṭṭha which is undesirable - bad - B) The -physical form - appearence- of Aniṭṭha which is undesirable
aniṭṭhasabhāva: [Aniṭṭha+sabhāva] (pu) CL=8 The nature / philosophy of Aniṭṭha which is undesirable - bad - See also Aniṭṭharūpa
aniṭṭhasammata:
[Aniṭṭha+sammata] (ti) CL=8 The matter which name as - Aniṭṭha - undesirable - bad -
See also Anariyasammama, Aniṭṭhābhimata

aniṭṭhaṅgatabhāva: [Aniṭṭhaṅgata+bhāva] (pu) CL=8 The state of not reaching to decisive stage - being indecisive -
aniṭṭhaṅgatatā: [Aniṭṭhaṅgata+tā] (thī) CL=8 The state of not reaching to decisive stage - being indecisive -
aniṭṭhita:
[Na+niṭṭhita] (ti) CL=8 Not finishing, not reaching to the finishing stage
See also Apariyositasaṅkappa
aniṭṭhitacchadana: [Aniṭṭhita+chadana] (ti) CL=8 Having the roof which is unfinished, Not yet finished roofing
aniṭṭhitamanoratha: [Aniṭṭhita+manoratha] (ti) CL=8 The person who has the desire which is not yet reaching to finished stage, who have incomplete desire
aniṭṭhurī: [Na+niṭṭhurī(=niṭṭhura+ī)] (ti) CL=8 The person who is not harsh and stern, who have no jealousy grudge.
aniṭṭhā: [Na+niṭṭhā] (thī) CL=7 Not concluded, uncertain, undecided. See - aniṭṭhaṅgata.
aniṭṭhābhimata: [Aniṭṭha+abhimata] (ti) CL=8 Being - desired - known as unpleasant thing
aniṭṭhākantavipāka: [Aniṭṭhākanta+vipāka] (pu) CL=8 The effect which is not desirable and liked
aniṭṭhākantavipākatta: [Aniṭṭhākantavipāka+tta] (na) CL=8 Being the effect which is not desirable and liked
aniṭṭhāpita: [Na+niṭṭhāpita] (ti) CL=8 Should not reach the end, should not finish
aniṭṭhārammaṇa: [Aniṭṭha+ārammaṇa] (na) CL=8 Undesirable - bad - sense of thought, unpleasant thing
